name: Haar Wavelet Transform on Omnitrees
definition: Haar wavelets on omnitrees represent piecewise constant functions f ∈ L^2([0,1]^d) hierarchically. The nodal representation stores f as sum over leaf nodes v with b(v)=0: f = Σ s^v φ^v, where φ^v is 1 if x ∈ rect(v), 0 else.
summary: Haar Wavelet Transform on Omnitrees converts nodal data into wavelet coefficients for compression, distinguished by explicitly defining mathematical basis functions for hierarchical piecewise constant decomposition.
